verdict.rationale: Synthesia documents scripted avatar videos (via the UI and the Video API), avatars of many styles, and uploading your own script audio for avatar videos. It also explicitly claims lip-sync for dubbing and translation, so the core of the story (characters speaking your dialogue with matched mouth movement) is delivered. One community report calls a deployed Synthesia avatar 'twitchy, hesitant, uncanny'; that is a criticism of realism, not a concrete lip-sync failure, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of lip-sync accuracy for avatars driven by your own script or uploaded audio (the explicit lip-sync claim covers only dubbing), and independent hands-on corroboration of lip-sync quality.
